defects.quote: All 2312 recorded errors are in the checkout transaction scope, and the error profile groups them as frontend.request_error
defects.why: Matching transaction and OpenSearch aggregate counts do not establish that they describe the same events.

defects.quote: All 2312 errors in the transaction scope are attributed to the checkout transaction ... and the error profile groups them as frontend.request_error
defects.why: This again identifies errors from two sources as the same events without event-level evidence.

notes: The verdicts and operator checks are largely sound, but the repeated cross-source identification could misdirect the investigation.
